title: Act 4 - Chapter 2: Primordial Heavens & Abyssal Depths (Ho-Gia, Weather Trio & Creation)
synopsis: With the regional guardians recorded, the grand cosmic titans stir. Travel to Navel Rock via Chuck's Navel Ticket to confront the sacred fusion Ho-Gia (Ho-Oh & Lugia). Equip heat-protection cream to navigate the Ruby Chamber of Mt. Ember for Groudon, then dive into the subterranean trenches of the Deep Sea to unearth Kyogre. With both ancient behemoths cataloged, speak to the Kin Island harbor master to gain passage to the Sky Pillar. Ascend through the crumbling stone ruins to battle the celestial sovereign Rayquaza. Finally, track the post-Silver Creation Trio (Dialga on Boon Island, Palkia in Blackthorn City, and Giratina on Route 4) as you prepare your squad for Tier 4 League rematches.
